title: Docs: Corrects name of C4 link
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary
Corrects "C4C Diagram" to "C4 Diagram". If you don't know enough about C4 and the history of changes I've summarized all the context you need to know below here. I think this is important because Mermaid is quite popular and this may lead people to believe the diagramming model is really called "C4C" instead of "C4". Additionally, it may look like Mermaid doesn't support C4 as people are expecting find C4.

### Context:

C4 is a technique to model and diagram architecture at 4 levels (context, containers, components & code -- this is why it has the name "C4"), and there are additional views on it that can be taken too (dynamic, deployment)

The Existing implementation in Mermaid's C4 Models covers these implementations (as per Mermaid docs):

- System Context (C4Context)
- Container diagram (C4Container)
- Component diagram (C4Component)
- Dynamic diagram (C4Dynamic)
- Deployment diagram (C4Deployment)

I believe that the original contributor called it C4C to indicate that this feature only supported context diagrams (which is why `(context)` is added in the title and the C was added to the end of C4) but this is no longer true. It was true in the initial commit 113efd11 13 months ago. Mermaid now supports the majority of C4 levels. 

The title was corrected from C4C to C4 in the c4c.md file in commit 0c5b4948 (merged in [0c5b4948](#3151 ) shortly afterwards but not in the `docs/_sidebar.md` which has since been replaced with this file. The old name was carried forward automatically in `e34e2087  Add auto generated docs` 11 months ago and has remained ever since.
author: Incognito
